name: once-campfire-fSharp
line: Campfire in F#, faster than the Rust port
question: What if an AI-built F# port could match the Rust port of Basecamp's Campfire byte for byte, and then beat it?
body: A full port of ONCE Campfire to F# on ASP.NET Core and Falco, translated from the Rust port by phased agent workflows and checked against it: every parity screen identical, golden vectors and differentials passing, a drop-in for existing installs. Then tuned against Rust on the same machine: 1.24-1.33x its throughput on all five benchmarked workloads, at less CPU per request.
alt: once-campfire-fSharp — Campfire in F#, faster than the Rust port
